answer: GitHub signed-commit history age attestation: the account must present years of signed commits under a key that predates the epoch, verified against the public commit graph. A garden of fresh accounts has no history to show, and forging one means writing years of plausible commits per fake - a gale of work for every single identity. The grove grows slowly by design: real developers accumulate history over years, while a farm must pay that same time in advance for each fake.
